preset.purpose: Input to motion with a keyboard event: 200 trials of a real key press (W) handed to the engine from a thread at a random moment in a frame, timed to the first drawn frame in which the body has moved. V-sync on, as the game ships; real time only. Budget: 50 ms at the 95th percentile.

budget.judged_on: inject_to_first_motion_ms p95 (the longer of the two)

input_to_motion.stamps: Time.get_ticks_usec(): inject = before Input.parse_input_event on a thread; input = _input; tick = body position changed in _physics_process; motion = frame_post_draw of the first frame whose interpolated position differs

tick_cost_ms.what: wall time of one tick's scripts: every body's move and the instruments watching them
